purpose: Arithmetic cross-check of matched quantities between the corrected analyses and Palaeo-Agent operations; not scientific validation (primer section 7).

rarefaction.scope: Input counts, subsample sizes and operation resource bounds checked; no rarefaction estimates computed

count_homogeneity.scope: Input, declared pairs, exact margins and backend bounds checked; no Monte Carlo tables sampled

community_relative.scope: Input structure and count semantics checked; no distance matrix or eigendecomposition computed

conventions.relative: relative tolerance 1e-12 for deterministic floats; 1e-10 for Fisher p-values (SciPy on both sides)
conventions.monte_carlo_mean: |analysis mean of 2000 hypergeometric subsamples - exact expectation| <= 3.29 x conditional SD / sqrt(2000)
conventions.taxa: matched by row position in llanvirn.dat; the analysis strips the _x_ label prefix, the API keeps raw labels
conventions.inverse_simpson: API reports Gini-Simpson 1 - sum p^2; compared as 1 / (1 - simpson)
